arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: William Barr argued that firms incur three specific costs when building networks.
William Barr stated that forward-looking perspectives clarify the legal issues.
William Olson argued that courts evaluate results rather than methodologies.
William Olson asserted that the statute does not mention compensating investors.
